tool_calls.name: run_sql
tool_calls.arguments:
{"sql":"WITH pc AS (
  SELECT TrackId, COUNT(DISTINCT PlaylistId) AS playlist_count
  FROM PlaylistTrack
  GROUP BY TrackId
),
mx AS (
  SELECT MAX(playlist_count) AS max_count FROM pc
)
SELECT t.TrackId, t.Name, pc.playlist_count, mx.max_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pc WHERE playlist_count = mx.max_count) AS tied_tracks
FROM pc JOIN mx ON 1=1 JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = pc.TrackId
WHERE pc.playlist_count = mx.max_count
ORDER BY t.TrackId;"}

SELECT t.TrackId, t.Name, pc.playlist_count, mx.max_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pc WHERE playlist_count = mx.max_count) AS tied_tracks
FROM pc JOIN mx ON 1=1 JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = pc.TrackId
WHERE pc.playlist_count = mx.max_count
ORDER BY t.TrackId;"}
